Hartalika Teej and Ganesh Chaturthi Dates for 2026 Clarified

In 2026, both the Haritalika Teej and Ganesh Chaturthi festivals are expected to fall on the same day due to the coincidence of the Tritiya and Chaturthi tithis (lunar days). This convergence creates a special astrological alignment for the year. The coverage provides information on when these festivals will be observed and the auspicious timings for their respective rituals. Haritalika Teej involves an 'nirjala' (waterless) fast observed by women.
